$comment: Field-level retention schedule (spec §12.4: 보존은 단일 '30일' 규칙으로 축약하지 않고 field별 schedule로 관리한다).
This file is the authority; apps/server/src/privacy loads it and docs/ops/data-map.md is generated from it.
Exactly one entry — viewer_consent.identity, personalIdentifiers: "consented_identity" — stores a user name and
a channel id, and only for viewers who opted in with the JOIN command (BOARD D-9, migration 006). Every other
entry declares personalIdentifiers: "none" and the schema has no column for a name, a channel id or a
reversible/stable hash outside that one table (spec §7.4, §12.4; audited by privacy/identity-columns.ts).
spec §12.4: client-side consent 철회는 token을 즉시 revoke하고 그 동의로 접근·저장한 Authorized Data를 최대 7일
안에 삭제한다 / Google 설정에서의 권한 철회는 정책의 별도 최대 30일 규칙을 적용한다.
Deletion runs immediately in both branches; the branch decides the recorded deadline (allowed_until).

fields.purpose: policy-filtered ingest inbox: single-writer replay after a restart and event-key idempotency (spec §7.3(1)(2)(3)(4), §10.2). `argument_rejected` is a boolean marker saying a command argument outside the content vocabulary was removed before the write (T8); the removed token itself is never stored
fields.specRef: §12.4 일반 Authorized/Non-Authorized API Data는 정책에 따라 30일 안에 refresh 또는 delete한다 / A-7

fields.purpose: reconnect continuation token committed with the envelopes it covers (spec §7.3(2))
fields.specRef: §12.4 30일 refresh-or-delete. A token untouched for 30 days points at a live chat that no longer exists

fields.purpose: audit trail of committed transitions; the cause column carries the API message id inside the event key (spec §7.3(5), §9.4(2))
durable outbox for side effects that cannot be regenerated, i.e. paid audit staging (spec §7.3(6)(7), §10.2)
paid audit idempotency: the same Super Chat is applied once (spec §7.4, §11 유료 무결성). Amount, tier and jewels are staging and event-analysis data only — 확정 수익은 AdSense 정산이 권위값이다 (spec §8.6)
fields.specRef: §12.4 30일 refresh-or-delete + §8.6 (장기 수익 정본은 정산, 장기 KPI는 무식별 집계)

fields.purpose: non-decreasing gift combo maximum per base event key, so a replayed combo step applies delta 0 (spec §7.4)
fields.specRef: §12.4 30일 refresh-or-delete. The row has no instant of its own: it exists only to deduplicate against inbox rows, so it expires with the last inbox row for its base key

fields.purpose: absolute UTC deadlines with the per-kind downtime policy; content-defined payloads carry no source data (spec §10.2)
fields.specRef: §12.4 field별 schedule. Internal state, but a settled deadline older than the source-data window has no further use

fields.purpose: broadcast/stream/live-chat resource ids plus the lifecycle bookkeeping that makes a reconcile possible (spec §9.1, §9.2, §9.3; columns fixed by T10 migration 003). The attempt columns are this host's own state, but the row is deleted as a unit, so they are declared under the stricter authorized-API-data rule rather than a weaker one of their own

current authoritative world state the renderer recovers from, plus the writer's own domain state (`engine_state_json`, T8: seed, step counter, need pressures, variation rings, schedule and the paid audit rings). Derived creature/environment/aggregate values only — neither the snapshot contract nor the engine state has a field for an author, a display name or a chat line; the paid rings hold event keys, which name a message and not a person (spec §10.2, §12.4 장기 KPI는 개인 식별자가 없는 집계)
fields.specRef: §12.4 장기 보존이 허용된 …은 30일마다 권한과 삭제 여부를 다시 확인한다. The row is rewritten on every state transition; a snapshot untouched for 30 days is reported for re-verification instead of being deleted, because deleting it would destroy the world the renderer recovers from

$comment: BOARD D-9 (Gate 0 §1.3 = B): only a viewer who sent the JOIN command after the notice is stored here.
checked 2026-08-19) caps Authorized Data outside the III.E.4.b exceptions at 30 calendar days, and a
display name is not one of those exceptions. The only refresh path is the viewer's next message, which
re-delivers both values and rewrites last_active_at, so 30 days without a message means the data stopped
being refreshed and the row is deleted. D-9's original '90일 미활동 삭제' was corrected to 30 by the
coordinator on 2026-08-19 for that reason; the loader refuses any value above 30 for this field.
Re-joining after a deletion is a fresh JOIN, which issues a fresh channel_ref.
fields.purpose: consented viewer identity (BOARD D-9): channel_id is the deletion key and the only copy of the raw id, display_name is shown next to '방금 반영된 행동' (spec §5.2(2)) and used for nothing else, channel_ref is the opaque reference the contract carries instead of the id, notice_version records which notice text was agreed to, last_active_at is the [S41] III.E.4.c refresh instant. No per-viewer counter, no message history, no D1/D7/D30 series (spec §14.1)
fields.specRef: §12.4 명시적 고지·동의·삭제 경로 + [S41] III.E.4.c 30 calendar days / III.E.4.g 사용자 삭제 요청 7일 (D-9)

fields.purpose: long-term KPI as identifier-free per-day/per-broadcast aggregates (spec §12.4 장기 KPI, §14.1). Official Analytics figures, internal identifier-free event counts and confirmed settlement stay separate (spec §12.4 [S42])
fields.specRef: §12.4 장기 보존이 허용된 Analytics·Reporting·일부 statistics는 30일마다 권한과 삭제 여부를 다시 확인한다

schemaOnlyTables.reason: This file's own audit trail: field key, source, purpose, allowed deadline, outcome, row count and deletion instant. It is the §12.4 evidence that deletions ran, holds no API data and no identifier, and is therefore retained rather than swept — deleting it would destroy the record the policy requires
Migration bookkeeping (version, name, checksum, applied_at). No API data and no user data
SQLite's own AUTOINCREMENT bookkeeping for ingest_inbox. Holds the highest sequence ever used so a deleted ingest_seq is never reused (https://sqlite.org/autoinc.html); no API data
